 11.09.2026 Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} Share current article via %{socialType} "Madden" co-executive producer Constance Schwartz-Morini (r) joins the latest SBJ Sports Media Podcast to discuss the film ahead of its Nov. 18 debut. SBJ Fox Sports’ Erin Andrews hit a milestone on the sideline of Sunday’s Packers-Patriots matchup: her 300th NFL game . She’s also looking to grow her various hosting roles on other shows and expand her fashion line. 
 On the latest SBJ Sports Media Podcast , Josh Carpenter and I look at what’s behind lower college football viewership and who might take Ernie Johnson’s seat on “Inside the NBA” after this season. Meanwhile, SMAC Entertainment’s Constance Schwartz-Morini, talks about her role as executive producer on the new “Madden” movie and her new podcast with Michael Strahan.
 With LIV Golf now in the dustbin of sports business history, Carpenter looks at its legacy, including broadcast innovations that came about from a five-year existence. 
 For the first time, “ The Rich Eisen Show ” is expanding to international markets, becoming available on Disney+ in select countries in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
 The WNBA Finals hit its best average since 1999, with the seven-game Valkyries-Dream matchup averaging 1.9 million viewers across NBC, USA, CNBC, Syfy and E! 
 Former Maryland football coach Mike Locksley joined the Big Ten Network, reports SBJ’s Matt Fortuna , giving the conference network a credible voice for the final month of the regular season.
